plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 6th house: they bring warmth to your routines and work; affection through helping, a pleasant daily rhythm. Failure mode: love reduced to being useful. Let them care for you; keep the romance alive too.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
